finding: Iteration 4's re-scope (CROWD_MIN_DISTINCT_LEVELS=2), whose whole purpose was to stop the whole-ring cull firing in genuinely flat/uncrowded regions (the torus lower band, review-3's REJECT reason), turns out to ALSO fully restore cone's flat base region and cylinder's entire wall. For both primitives the mechanism is now COMPLETELY INERT at this configuration (26 slice planes) — every post-iteration-4 metric is byte-identical to the cull-disabled ground truth. This is NOT a regression: it is the same class of fix already made for torus/sphere's over-culled flat regions, just discovered here for the first time (review-4 §8 found this collateral scope was never measured or tested before this unit). No STOP was warranted; scene3d.js was not touched.
why_inert: Cylinder's wall is a stack of parallel, evenly-spaced circles with zero genuine multi-level convergence (no saddle, no pole) — CROWD_MIN_DISTINCT_LEVELS=2 can never fire there. Cone's apex is too sparse (2 rings only) to ever produce a >=2-distinct-level pileup at 26 slice planes, and its base/wall are otherwise as uncrowded as the cylinder's. Iteration 3's own over-culling on both primitives (79.6%/88.46% retained) was pure collateral damage from the unscoped whole-ring test, not a fix for anything real on cone/cylinder.

regression_guards_added.rgr_proof: 4 of 6 fail at 47a5a755 (pre-fix) via a from-scratch scratch export run; all 6 pass at c6dd6130 (HEAD). See W-27c-0a-4b-impl.md for the exact assertion-level RED/GREEN numbers.

disclosure_per_review_4_section_4: The four existing torus/sphere floor+10% bars (engine-pipeline waist/largestW, added in iteration 4) are pinned AT their RED values because — per review-4's own independent mutation testing — under this mechanism's subtractive-only, whole-ring design, the pairwise-minimum self-approach (waist) can only stay the same or increase, and the largest-merged-blob-width (largestW) can only stay the same or shrink, as the cull is tuned MORE aggressive. RED is therefore a structural ceiling/floor for those two quantities that no tuning of CROWD_CULL_K / CROWD_MIN_ARC_MULT / CROWD_MIN_DISTINCT_LEVELS can ever cross. Those four bars cannot fail from retuning this mechanism's own constants; their only reachable failure mode is an unrelated future change to the shared projector/refinement/clipper code they also depend on. This test-file comment (and this same disclosure) now also covers the new cone/cylinder guards added by this unit, which are byte-identical to their own cull-inert ground truth for the identical structural reason.

conclusion: No STOP required.
